[b][b]1. navigate to your Stardew Valley Contents folder.[/b][b]
[/b]
[b]    ( e.g. for PC - C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Content )[/b]
[b]    ([s] im sorry GOG or mac or linux users, idk :[[/s] )[/b]

[b]2. search for the files : ( as shown : "folder name" > "file name".xnb )[/b]

[b]    Portraits > Shane.xnb[/b]
[b]    Character > Shane.xnb[/b]
[b]    Character > Shane_JojaMart.xnb[/b]

[b]3. back them up in a separate content backups folder, if you wanna, you do you.[/b]

[b]     tips : - model your backups folder similar to that of the Content folder, so you don't confuse or replace anything in the future.[/b]
[b]               - don't forget to copy ! hold the "ctrl" key while dragging the file. you really don't want missing assets that crash your game.[/b]

[b]4. [b]now replace these specific .xnb files with your newly downloaded .xnb files from your's truly :][/b][/b]
[b]     tip : it's nice to have a separate mod folder too to store your downloaded files, so you know what's what running in your game.[/b]

[b]5. you're all set to run the game and enjoy your husbandos or waifus or mutuals !
[/b]
[b]    note : you can revert back by simply replacing the current .xnb files in the Content folder with your backed-up ones. Remember to copy !! CTRL CTRL
CTRLLLLLL !
[/b]
